title: provider.py read and search get the PowerShell twin of their allow rules, as the other read-only kb commands have
goal: Retrospective of SP-sbdy4hsx: the settings-allow gates of ST-7zkw23ca and ST-nkr6cpvs were answered Bash(python3 _tools/provider.py read *) and search only, so .claude/settings.json has no PowerShell twin of either, while kb/_self/maintaining.md's setup step says the read-only kb commands are allowed for both shell tools; on Windows each call prompts. An operator gate decides whether both get their PowerShell(...) twin; on yes, the settings hold both and maintaining.md names them.

run: import json,sys; a=json.load(open('.claude/settings.json'))['permissions']['allow']; sys.exit(0 if all('PowerShell(python3 _tools/provider.py %s *)' % c in a for c in ('read','search')) else 1)
